term: same individual across world-local grounding copies
resolution: Literal identity is equality of the entire (tag, source coordinate) pair. Counterparts and cross-profile matching preserve source coordinates on existing fibers, so the same role may have differently tagged individuals. At world false both profiles have literally the same data; at other worlds their local structures correspond without equating tagged bearers. Coherent composition and bijection do not supply numerical identity. Neither profile is shown physically or metaphysically adequate.
